note: What a place can put in front of a character. A beat is anchored to a location and is true while the character is in that location's district; the engine picks it deterministically from the day, so nothing here is a roll and nothing here is the narrator's decision. Two kinds live here. A TAG beat is anchored to ground rather than to a venue, so it is written once and works in every district that has the ground for it — that is what stops a district being bare. A NAMED beat is anchored to one location by key and is about that location and nowhere else, which is what stops every district feeling the same; when both fit, the named one takes the slot.
capNote: How many place beats may be live at once. Two. The Life funnel scores them against rent, wounds and people like everything else, and a place that offers four things at once is a quest board.

beats.title: The water truck didn't make it today
beats.summary: The carwash is selling clean drinking water. The line runs half the block and it is not getting shorter.

beats.title: The elevator is dead again
beats.summary: The building manager wants thirty a resident toward parts. Until somebody pays, it is the stairs.

beats.title: Somebody is moving in two containers down
beats.summary: A family, by the look of the load. Half the terrace has come out to watch and nobody is offering to help.

beats.title: The reclaimers need hands
beats.summary: Somebody destroyed three of the rooftop growing beds in the night. Nobody there thinks it was random.

beats.title: Night market in the west concourse
beats.summary: One of the Fixers running the place has opened it up for the evening. Word is somebody is carrying military-grade optics.

beats.title: The queue for clean water goes round the block
beats.summary: Whatever went wrong upstream, it has not been fixed, and the people at the front got there hours ago.

beats.title: There has been a cancellation
beats.summary: Somebody with an appointment did not turn up, and somebody else is going to take the slot.

beats.title: Somebody has been stripping the place
beats.summary: Copper, mostly, and whatever else came away with it. The work is recent enough to still be going on.

beats.title: There is a toll on this street today
beats.summary: Not a robbery. A price, quoted politely, by people who are standing where you need to walk.

beats.title: The water pressure has gone again
beats.summary: Everyone on this side of the stack is carrying bottles up. Somebody says it is the pump; somebody says it is the bill.

beats.title: They are short of hands
beats.summary: Not enough people for what needs doing before dark, and they are asking anyone standing nearby.

beats.title: A container came in that nobody has papers for
beats.summary: It is sitting where it was dropped. Two people are already arguing about whose problem that makes it.

beats.title: Somebody has been asking about you in here
beats.summary: Not by name. By description, which is worse, and whoever it was did not leave one of their own.

beats.title: A floor is being emptied
beats.summary: Crates, shredders, and people carrying their own chairs out. Nobody upstairs will say whether it is a move or a cut.

beats.title: Somebody's badge has stopped working
beats.summary: They are still at the barrier arguing about it, and the queue behind them has started to take an interest.

beats.title: The results came back wrong
beats.summary: Somebody wants a second pair of hands and no questions before the morning shift arrives and reads the log.

beats.title: They are looking for somebody who was there
beats.summary: A producer is paying for a first-hand account and is not fussy about whose hands it came through on the way.

beats.title: The precinct is running a sweep
beats.summary: Vans out front and a list somebody has been adding to all week. Being near the front steps today is a decision.

beats.title: The queue reaches the door
beats.summary: Whatever they are processing today, everybody in the district needs it, and there are two windows open.

beats.title: There is something on this evening
beats.summary: A lecture, a recital or a demonstration, and the doors are open to anyone willing to sit at the back.

beats.title: The line is down again
beats.summary: Nobody has said for how long. Half the platform has given up and started walking; the other half is still hoping.

beats.title: A transfer is being held
beats.summary: Nothing is wrong with it, they say. It is being reviewed, and reviews take exactly as long as they take.

beats.title: Somebody is moving out at three in the morning
beats.summary: Quietly, thoroughly, and with rather more people helping than a move of this size ought to need.

beats.title: A room has gone unclaimed
beats.summary: Paid up through the week and nobody has been back to it. The desk would rather it were somebody else's problem.

beats.title: They are short in the kitchen tonight
beats.summary: Somebody did not turn up, the room is full, and the person asking has stopped caring about your references.

beats.title: The night shift is short again
beats.summary: They will take anybody who can stay upright for eight hours, and they will not ask a great deal beyond that.

beats.title: There is a service this evening
beats.summary: The doors are open, and the room fills with people who would not otherwise stand in the same building.

beats.title: The waiting room has stopped moving
beats.summary: Something came in that took the whole department. Everybody else is sitting exactly where they were an hour ago.

beats.title: They are rehearsing with the doors open
beats.summary: Not a performance, and better than one: somebody inside is trying something that is not working yet.

beats.title: The families are moving on
beats.summary: Packing has started, the argument about the route is well underway, and nobody has said how long they will be gone.

beats.title: Somebody has called a meeting at Holy Angels
beats.summary: Two sides who would shoot each other on the street have agreed to sit down. Father Kevin is holding the weapons.

beats.title: Something has landed in the Library
beats.summary: A dump nobody has claimed, sitting in Short Circuit's shared architecture. Half the second floor is already reading it.

beats.title: Norman has been asking after somebody
beats.summary: Not you. Somebody who drinks here, who has not been in for a week, and whose name he will not say out loud.

beats.title: A name went up on the board at the Afterlife
beats.summary: Somebody died well enough to be remembered, and the wake has turned into the busiest night of the month.

beats.title: There is an argument about a mooring
beats.summary: One of the FloatHomes has drifted onto somebody else's water, and neither owner is treating it as an accident.

beats.title: City Medical is turning people away
beats.summary: Whatever came in overnight has taken every bed. The queue outside has stopped being a queue and become a crowd.

beats.title: Delirium has changed who it lets in
beats.summary: New faces on the door and a list that was not there last week. Regulars are standing outside looking insulted.

beats.title: Firestation #2 is running short
beats.summary: Half the appliances are out on something nobody will describe, and the district is quietly uninsured for the evening.

beats.title: Totentanz is open to anyone tonight
beats.summary: Maelstrom have opened the doors, which they do occasionally, for reasons that have never been satisfactorily explained.

beats.title: Toggle has something in
beats.summary: Salvage out of the Zone, still warm, and Toggle is being unusually specific about who is allowed to look at it.

beats.title: The Forlorn Hope is full tonight
beats.summary: Every table taken and half of them by people who do not normally drink together. Something has happened somewhere.

beats.title: Bridgetown is taking water again
beats.summary: The lower containers are ankle-deep and rising. Everyone who can lift is moving somebody else's belongings upstairs.

beats.title: The campus has gone to lockdown
beats.summary: NCU Campus Security has closed the gates and will not say why. Several thousand people are inside and cannot leave.

beats.title: A seed shipment reached Stems & Seeds
beats.summary: Rare stock, badly needed, and worth rather more to certain people than the people who ordered it are aware.

beats.title: There are lights on in Princessland
beats.summary: The park has been dead for years. Somebody has power running to it tonight, and it is not the city.

beats.title: Precinct #1 is briefing for something
beats.summary: Every shift held over, vehicles staged in the yard, and nobody outside the building has been told what for.

beats.title: City Hall is voting on something today
beats.summary: The public gallery is open, the item is buried at number nine, and three people in the district stand to lose everything.

beats.title: There is a demonstration in the Plaza
beats.summary: Peaceful so far, larger than anyone planned for, and ringed by people being paid to decide when it stops being peaceful.

beats.title: Mrs. Suzuki has been cleaned out
beats.summary: The bodega's shelves went in a morning. Whoever bought it bought all of it, and paid without arguing.

beats.title: Hiro has a car nobody has claimed
beats.summary: On the lot, papers absent, and a Nomad family has been past twice today looking at it without stopping.

beats.title: There is a procession through the Boneyard
beats.summary: The Sinful Adams are burying one of their own, and the whole district has come out to be seen not interfering.

beats.title: There is a card on at the Slammer
beats.summary: Wild Things business, an open gate, and a purse large enough that people have travelled for it.

beats.title: Savage Docs has been busy all night
beats.summary: Three arrivals since dark, none of them walking. Whatever happened, it happened to a crew rather than a person.

beats.title: The Thelas Marines are walking the cargo community
beats.summary: Not a raid. A count, door by door, of who is living in what, and the count is being written down.

beats.title: Medical Technologies has taken delivery
beats.summary: Chrome, unpapered, and the sort that does not usually reach the Port. It will not be there in a week.

beats.title: Herschel has somebody nobody has claimed
beats.summary: A body, a week old, and an undertaker who will not put anyone in the ground without a name to say over them.

beats.title: Somebody stripped the Yard overnight
beats.summary: Parts gone that the city's transport needs by Monday. The reclaimers are furious and are not calling anybody official.

beats.title: From the Ashes has run out
beats.summary: Blood, plasma, and most of what a clinic needs to be one. Edgerunners Inc are asking anyone who can spare either.

beats.title: There is a light in the semiconductor building
beats.summary: Nobody has run that plant in twenty years. Somebody is running something in it tonight.

beats.title: The Main Gate has closed to everyone
beats.summary: No traffic in or out, no explanation, and NorCal Military Police standing where they do not normally stand.

beats.title: The Motor Pool is taking inventory
beats.summary: Everything out of the sheds and onto the apron, counted twice, by people who look like they expect the count to be wrong.

beats.title: The Redline is running tonight
beats.summary: Wild Things have the gate open and the pit lit. The crowd is already too large for the ground it is standing on.

beats.title: Trauma Team has grounded its birds
beats.summary: Every AV on the pad and none of them moving. Whoever is paying for the pause is paying a great deal for it.

beats.title: The last train out of Red Oktober is late
beats.summary: Two hundred people on a platform with nowhere to be until it comes, and the bar attached to it has noticed.

beats.title: The Nakagawa has a full house tonight
beats.summary: The troupe is performing and the Co-Prosperity Sphere's leadership is in the building. So is everybody who wants something from them.

beats.title: Something came in across the Pacific
beats.summary: Ganymede Street has stock this morning that was not on any manifest, and the stalls are pricing it accordingly.

beats.title: Network 54 is running it tonight
beats.summary: A story is going out at the top of the hour, the district is in it, and nobody in the district has been asked about it.

beats.title: North Cargo Village is being cleared
beats.summary: Notices on the containers, a date on the notices, and the date is close enough that people have started packing.

beats.title: Rocklin Augmentics is recruiting volunteers
beats.summary: Paid, medical, and the consent form is four pages of things that will not happen to you and one page of what might.

beats.title: Somebody has been visiting a grave in Seral Grove
beats.summary: Repeatedly, out of hours, and the reconstruction they have been talking to has started saying things it should not know.

beats.title: Anjelika has an evening free
beats.summary: Which never happens, and she is not saying who cancelled or why they are not going to need the appointment.

beats.title: The Verge has lost its water point
beats.summary: Cut from the other side of the wall, according to everyone here, and nobody on that side is answering.

beats.title: Lazarus is changing the gatehouse roster
beats.summary: New faces, unfamiliar with the district's regulars, and for about a week the wall is only as good as a list.

beats.title: The Oasis is running a delivery round
beats.summary: Drones out to the estates all afternoon, each one carrying a manifest that says who is home and what they wanted.

beats.title: The Weighbridge has found a discrepancy
beats.summary: A load that weighed one thing on arrival and another on release. SK Security have stopped everything until it resolves.

beats.title: Something is landing at Cargo Way after dark
beats.summary: Not on the schedule, not lit, and the crew working it were not the crew rostered for tonight.

beats.title: The Armory is taking orders again
beats.summary: 6th Street have stock in and are writing names down. What you can have depends entirely on whose name is above yours.

beats.title: The animal shelter has run out of room
beats.summary: Somebody dumped a crate of bioexotics at the door overnight and the clinic behind it is not equipped for any of them.

beats.title: Xanadu is going all night
beats.summary: The stadium floor is open, the card is long, and the crowd has been arriving since the afternoon.

beats.title: Yang's Wheels has more work than hands
beats.summary: A fleet job with a deadline attached, and Yang has started asking people in the street whether they can hold a spanner.

beats.title: The Rambling Rose has shifted again
beats.summary: The old hull moved in the night and the people living in it have moved with it. Somebody is going to have to go down there.

beats.title: An Aldecaldo convoy is coming in
beats.summary: Family arriving off the road, which means food, news from the Badlands, and three days of nobody in the camp sleeping much.

beats.title: Woodchipper's is holding a swap meet
beats.summary: Half the district's vehicles in one yard, parts changing hands, and the Steel Vaqueros running the gate as a courtesy.

beats.title: Precinct #2 has gone quiet
beats.summary: Nobody answering, nobody dispatching, and the Aldecaldo Peacekeepers have started covering calls that are not theirs.

beats.title: Playland is lit up tonight
beats.summary: Somebody has power to the front of the park for the first time in months, and the Piranhas are claiming credit.

beats.title: There is a meeting at the Playhouse
beats.summary: The building has filled with people who live here and one person who does not, and that person is doing the talking.

beats.title: Bits'n'Bolts has taken a delivery
beats.summary: Parts the district has not seen since the resort closed, and Voodoo Boys money is the obvious explanation nobody says.

signalNote: The mark a beat wears on the map, from the closed list in placeSignals.ts. Omitted, a beat is an event (or a person, when its category is people) — a beat has to ask to be anything more eye-catching than a warning.
